sessionStart.prompt: Read AGENTS.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md to understand project conventions before starting work.

preToolUse.bash: echo '{"decision": "allow"}' # Allow all pre-approved tools by default

postToolUse.bash: if echo "$COPILOT_HOOK_TOOL_NAME" | grep -q 'write'; then echo 'File modified - typecheck recommended'; fi

agentStop.bash: cd /workspace && npm run typecheck 2>/dev/null && echo '{"decision": "allow"}' || echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "TypeScript errors detected. Please fix before completing.", "additionalContext": "Run npm run typecheck to see errors."}'
